_comment: Miss Aria egg for Pterodactyl-style panels. Import via Admin -> Nests -> Import Egg. UNTESTED end-to-end (no Pterodactyl instance available to actually import this into) — the JSON structure follows the documented PTDL_v2 schema, but verify a real import before relying on it.
name: Miss Aria
author: owner@example.com

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Real install script — installs the exact same system libraries the
# Dockerfile does (canvas/puppeteer/better-sqlite3 native builds), then
# runs npm install. Long-running: puppeteer downloads Chromium unless
# PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD is set as an egg variable.
apt-get update
apt-get install -y python3 make g++ \
  libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libjpeg-dev libgif-dev librsvg2-dev \
  libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libdrm2 libxkbcommon0 \
  libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libasound2 \
  libpangocairo-1.0-0 libgtk-3-0
cd /mnt/server
npm install --omit=dev
echo "Install complete."

variables.name: Owner WhatsApp Number
variables.description: The WhatsApp number (with country code, digits only) that should be treated as the bot owner. Sets OWNER_NUMBER in the environment.

variables.name: Status Server Port
variables.description: Port for the health/status endpoint (server/statusServer.js). Most panels auto-assign this via the allocation system.
